commit_message: Add ACP startup cancellation and progress controls
pr_title: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- block duplicate Send while ACP startup or an ACP Ask answer is active
- expose startup/answer progress and Stop controls without blocking egui
- cancel Ask/Build startup ownership and clean up sessions that finish after cancellation
- prevent deleting sessions with ACP startup/Ask activity
- add controlled startup failure/cancellation tests and deterministic Editor visual evidence

A final cleanup slice removes the temporary synchronous compatibility seam, records the ADR 0166 presentation-thread rule, and resolves formatting/validation findings.
